title: ReGRA: Residual-Gradient Adaptation for Complementary Low-Rank Fine-Tuning
abstract: arXiv:2610.19700v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Low-rank adaptation (LoRA) enables parameter-efficient fine-tuning by learning low-rank weight updates. Increasing rank expands adaptation capacity, but does not guarantee that all learned directions improve downstream performance. In a diagnostic experiment with rank-16 LoRA, we show that retaining only the top singular components achieves the best performance, whereas adding further components degrades it. Motivated by this, we propose Residual-Gradient Adaptation (ReGRA), a two-stage method for making more effective use of a fixed rank budget. After the first stage, ReGRA estimates task gradients on a calibration set and removes their projections onto the two-sided subspace induced by the first-stage update. It then aggregates the residual-gradient directions to initialize a second-stage adapter without changing the first-stage update. translated_title: ReGRA：面向互补低秩微调的残差梯度自适应方法
translated_abstract: 低秩自适应通过学习低秩权重更新实现了参数高效的微调。提高秩虽然能扩大自适应能力，但并不能保证所有学到的方向都能改善下游性能。在一项秩为16的LoRA诊断实验中，我们发现仅保留顶部奇异分量即可取得最佳性能，而引入更多分量反而会导致性能下降。受此启发，我们提出了残差梯度自适应，这是一种旨在更有效利用固定秩预算的两阶段方法。在第一阶段完成后，ReGRA在校准集上估计任务梯度，并去除其在第一阶段更新所诱导的双侧子空间上的投影，随后聚合这些残差梯度方向来初始化第二阶段的适配器，同时保持第一阶段的更新不变。正交正则项则鼓励两次更新捕获互补的方向。两者结……
tldr: ReGRA提出一种两阶段低秩微调方法，通过去除任务梯度在第一阶段更新子空间上的投影并聚合残差梯度方向来初始化第二阶段适配器，使有限秩预算下的两次更新捕获互补方向，从而提升微调效果。
